metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Batman: Knightfall - Part 1: Knightfall
metas.description: When the mysterious behemoth known only as Bane frees Batman's entire rogue's gallery from Arkham Asylum, the Caped Crusader is pushed to his mental and physical breaking point.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2025 · Shaunki Sardar
metas.description: A mentor returns from prison to find his former proteges transformed. Their reunion stirs up complex bonds of loyalty and hidden tensions as they face their shared past and present challenges.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2025 · The Devil
metas.description: Rajashekar (Chief Minister of Karnataka) is framed, so his secretary recruits Krishna, a kindhearted lookalike, to impersonate the violent heir Dhanush. When the real Dhanush returns, both men clash for political power and Rukmini’s love. Krishna must protect Rukmini from Dhanush while also rising as a leader the people trust.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2026 · Mission C1000
metas.description: Hindu Atankwad and the Honey Trap is a film about a character named Ram who tries to stop terrorists from stealing a scientific formula. The movie explores themes of patriotism, cultural identity, and the fight against terrorism

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Forgotten Island
metas.description: Two best friends become stranded on the mystical world of Nakali, where their only escape might cost them their shared lifetime of memories.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Maremma
metas.description: In a village bound by ancient traditions, the Maremma Goddess festival is a time of both reverence and fear. Every 12 years, a male bull is sacrificed to the deity, yet with each ceremony, calamity befalls the villagers. Despite their efforts, the elders fail to prevent disaster. Determined to break the cycle, they enact a new decree: any household whose bull bears a male calf in the next 100 days must offer it to the goddess. As the deadline approaches, the fate of the village hangs in the balance, and the true test of their resolve begins.
